metadata.purpose: Building footprint shell. Click for the building summary.
Active floor panel. Filtered to the active FloorID (default 6).
Active floor's units as a clickable tile plan. Color by UseType. Hover/click handled by the kacst_demo_unit_hover / _selected layers.
Hovered unit. App sets filter to the hovered GlobalID__. Matches nothing by default.
Selected unit. App sets filter to the selected GlobalID__. Matches nothing by default.
3D floor slabs, shown by default (all floors stacked). The viewer toggles to a 2D plan to click individual units.
